fresh_candidate_requirement.target_rule: Use a fresh canonical root. Do not update the applied @3 target in place.
fresh_candidate_requirement.transfer_rule: No @2 acceptance, @3 apply authorization, inventory digest, material digest, semantic digest, review binding, selection evidence, or chain approval transfers to repaired bytes.

logical_changed_byte_inventory.new_candidate_target_rule: A fresh candidate inventory must still enumerate all canonical target creates, including content-identical inherited targets; 32 is only the minimum content-delta set relative to @3.

repair_operations.requirement: In the fresh candidate, every current acceptance, candidate, title, execution-input, and gate statement must bind the fresh candidate identity. Preserve @2 only in explicitly historical provenance and non-transfer statements.
Regenerate every material, handoff, and live-validation command binding so --contracts receives the directory containing exactly ten TDE-EPOCH-*-VALIDATION.json documents.

required_revalidation: Generate a complete fresh target inventory and verify every staged postimage before apply, including create-only and untracked targets.

Run candidate-identity and lifecycle wording validation over the exact staged bytes; reject current acceptance or identity references to a predecessor candidate unless explicitly marked historical provenance.
Run validate_tde_unit_contracts.py with --contracts bound to the validation-contracts directory and require exit 0, RESULT: pass, and unit_count 10.
Reject the same command when --contracts is a regular file, missing, or does not contain exactly ten matching contracts.

Regenerate and validate material package, receipt, handoff, changed-byte inventory, candidate manifest, target inventory, material digest, semantic digest, independent review bindings, and final owner acceptance request.
After separately authorized apply, prove live bytes equal every staged postimage, rerun all acceptance-critical validation in order, and preserve every nonzero exit.
Do not create selection evidence or chain approval until the fresh live candidate has exact Rondelli acceptance.
